What a find!
Oct 2019 • Couples
We were looking for a different sushi place (after leaving the Ganges without eating), but found this place 1st. Lucky us. 

The fish is both local and imported. The sashimi portion is generous and very fresh. After the salmon sashimi, we had a selection of grilled items and were very happy.

Garlic and ginkgo berries, bacon-wrapped asparagus, chicken yakitori and some mushrooms in garlic butter. It was all delicious. The beer was ice cold and delicious. The service was very attentive.

If we were local, this would be 'Our Place.'

Fish fresh, preparation area clean
Nov 2018 • Solo

The fish was fresh and the chef keeps the preparation area clean. I watched him keep the surfaces spotless in between creating dishes. The owner was walking around keeping everyone happy. He is obviously proud of his establishment. The couple next to me had eaten there most nights. I should have asked more questions as I missed out on some good looking dishes after I had ordered off the menu (it has pictures).
